_meta.title: huiying Filter Size Reference Ranges
_meta.purpose: Typical dimensional ranges for filters by vehicle class, and common oil-filter thread specifications. Public common-knowledge ranges for estimation only.
_meta.disclaimer: These are typical REFERENCE ranges, not measurements of any specific SKU. They are for planning and estimation only; never use them to confirm a part. Always match the exact part by OE / cross-reference number.

air_filter_by_class.label: Compact / C-segment
air_filter_by_class.example_vehicles: Corolla, Civic, Lavida, Focus, Elantra, Sylphy, Emgrand

air_filter_by_class.label: Mid-size / D-segment
air_filter_by_class.example_vehicles: Camry, Accord, Passat, 3 Series, C-Class, A4, Malibu

air_filter_by_class.label: SUV / Crossover
air_filter_by_class.example_vehicles: RAV4, CR-V, Tiguan, X3, GLC, Q5, Haval H6

oil_filter_threads.typical: Most common spin-on thread (Toyota, Honda, Ford, GM and many aftermarket)
Volkswagen Group, Mercedes-Benz and many European engines
Nissan, Subaru and some Japanese applications

cabin_filter_range: Panel type: L 200–320 × W 150–260 × H 15–40 mm (reference; carbon variants share footprint).
notes: Air-filter panel dimensions scale with engine displacement and vehicle class, not with brand.
Oil-filter thread is engine-specific; the same vehicle name can use different threads across model years and engines.
Never order on dimensional ranges alone — confirm the OE / cross-reference number first.
